arguments.text: 8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Goal: even effort near sustainable shaft power (about 175 W pod, CP 170 W) so the pod reserve reaches near zero only in the last 500 m; finish sprint from about 600 m to go. Start is hard: let it settle by minute 2-3; if pod power still well above 185 W at minute 3, cue ease. Watch for anything that slows the boat but not the paddler (weed on rudder, current, wind): compare push_local and same-direction legs. Check instruments against each other (pod vs boat model vs GPS) before acting on one.

arguments.message: Boat-model power fell versus pod power: drag (weed on rudder), current, or pod drift. Check push_local and legs.
Boat-model power rose versus pod power: pod may be reading low (drift) or tailwind/current.
Pod reserve below 30 % with more than 1500 m to go: ease toward critical power.
Pod power well below critical power: fading, blown up, or something wrong.

arguments.reason: check the start has settled near 175 W pod

arguments.text: Min 1: boat/pod power ratio about 0.58-0.59 (122/206, 104/179). Watches set: ratio_low (<0.49), ratio_high (>0.70), pod_reserve_low (<30 % with >1500 m left), power_drop (pod <0.88 CP after min 4). Wake-ups: race s 178 (settling check), 700 m to go (finish). Leg 1 heading north, push_along -0.19 (against).

text: no cue: start is hard as expected (pod 206 W vs CP 170 W); set plan, watches and a settling check at minute 3.

arguments.text: Good start. Settle a touch now, long smooth strokes.

arguments.reason: check the ease took: pod power should be near 175 W

text: cue ease: pod 190 W at minute 3, reserve 65 % and falling 12 %/min, above sustainable 174 W; check again at minute 5.6.

arguments.text: Still a bit hot. Ease slightly, bank it for the back half.

Min 5.6 (end leg 1): pod 186-190 W for 3 min after first ease cue (ease barely took: 192 to 187). Pod reserve 46 %, boat-model reserve 24 % (the two disagree; pod W prime 16 kJ is larger relative to CP). Paddler says 5/10, plenty. Speed through water steady 3.09-3.16 at rate 65: no fade yet. Possible CP underestimate; test: if pod reserve falls near 0 with no fade in speed at same rate, raise cp_shaft. Cued ease again at 5.6.

arguments.reason: check second ease cue, fade evidence, pod reserve trend

text: cue ease: pod 188 W above sustainable 173 W, pod reserve 46 % after 5.6 min; paddler feels fine (5/10) so watching for fade before changing CP.

arguments.message: Speed through the water at the same stroke rate faded more than 3 %: real tiredness (or drag).
Boat reserve model empty 150 s: if no fade, critical power is underestimated; consider set_critical_power.

arguments.reason: pod reserve near 0: check fade and decide on raising critical power

arguments.text: Min 7.3 (leg 2, south, current helps +0.24): second ease cue NOT followed (pod 189 to 199 W). Boat-model reserve 0 % yet fade +1.8 % (faster than early at same rate 65) and paddler again 5/10 plenty: evidence boat CP 105 W is too low. Pod reserve 28 %, empties in ~480 m at 199 W. Ratio boat/pod about 0.64. If pod reserve reaches 0 with no fade, raise cp_shaft (to about 190) and cp_w (to about 120). Added watches fade_real (fade below -3 %) and boat_reserve_empty_long.

text: no cue: paddler ignored two ease cues, feels 5/10 and shows no fade with the boat reserve model at 0; gathering evidence on critical power before acting.
no cue: pod 191 W, slight fade -1 % just appearing, pod reserve 18 %; the next wake-up in about a minute decides on critical power.

arguments.message: Pod reserve empty for 60 s while still above pod CP with no fade: critical power is underestimated; raise it.

text: no cue: boat reserve model empty 150 s with no fade (-0.4 %), so the boat calibration is too pessimistic; waiting for the pod reserve to empty (about 300 m) before correcting critical power.
no cue: pod reserve 9 %, paddler still holding 190 W with fade only -1.4 %; the pod_empty_no_fade watch will wake me when the evidence is in.

arguments.reason: Paddler held 190-193 W pod for 12.7 min (pod reserve model fell to 0, boat model empty since min 8) with no fade in speed at the same rate (-0.7 %), and says 6/10, could go harder. Pre-race CP underestimated; boat W prime 7.4 kJ also inconsistent with pod 16 kJ at boat/pod ratio 0.635.

arguments.text: Strong and smooth. Lift a little now, into the current.

8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back (out = north, into a current of about -0.25 m/s; back = south, helped about +0.25). CP corrected at min 12.7 to pod 192 W / 16 kJ, boat 122 W / 10 kJ (paddler held 190 W for 12.7 min, no fade, 6/10). Goal: hold about the sustainable shaft power to the finish, a little harder into the current on out legs and a little easier on back legs; finish sprint from about 600 m. If fade_real fires or effort reports jump to 8+ well before the finish, the correction was too high: ease and consider lowering CP (2 corrections left). Watch ratio boat/pod (about 0.63) for drag or pod drift.

Min 12.7 (leg 3 out, current -0.23, stronger than leg 1 -0.09): set_critical_power pod 170 to 192 W, boat 105 to 122 W, boat W prime 7.4 to 10 kJ; reserves now 90 boat / 87 pod. Cued push (lift into the current). Legs so far: leg1 out 193 W pod 2.97 m/s GPS; leg2 back 193 W 3.36; leg3 out 187 W 2.87.

arguments.reason: check push cue response, sustainable power after CP correction

text: raised CP (pod 192 W, boat 122 W) on 12.7 min at 190 W without fade and a 6/10 report, then cued a small push into the current.

arguments.message: Pod power more than 15 W above sustainable with over 800 m left: paddler pushing too hard, cue hold.

text: no cue: paddler is lifting as asked (sustainable now 200 W pod vs 192 W); added an overcook watch to catch a push more than 15 W above sustainable.

arguments.text: Ease back to steady now. Long strokes, five k to go.

Min 16.2 (turn into leg 4 back): after push cue pod rose 188 to 212 W but GPS speed fell 2.93 to 2.82 (lower than at 188 W); push_local slid -0.21 to -0.33 over 5 min; boat/pod ratio 0.63 to 0.565; fade -2.5 %. Paddler effort jumped 6 to 9 (starting to feel it). Cued ease. Diagnose on leg 4 back: push_local about +0.35 = current strengthened; about +0.15 or less = drag (weed, consider clear_rudder) or tired blade or pod drift. CP 192 may be too high if effort stays 9.

arguments.reason: compare push_local on leg 4 back with leg 2 (+0.26) to tell current from drag

text: cue ease: effort jumped to 9/10 and boat speed fell despite more pod power; checking the back leg to tell current from drag.

arguments.reason: Race committee radio at min 16.7: course shortened by one leg, finish now at 7000 m.
cue allowed: tell paddler new finish (7000 m) and diagnose back-leg push_local (drag vs current)

arguments.text: Min 16.7: radio from race committee, course shortened by one leg, finish now 7000 m (end of leg 7, an out leg). set_race_distance 7000 done (3941 m left). Paddler not told yet (cue gate). Start of leg 4 back: push_local only -0.07 (leg 2 back was +0.26) at pod 177 W, GPS 2.86 m/s: big deficit, suspect drag (weed on rudder) if it persists after the turn settles.

text: set race distance to 7000 m after the committee radio; will tell the paddler when the cue gate opens and check for drag on this back leg.

arguments.text: Course shortened. Finish is end of leg seven, 3.8 k.

arguments.reason: Effort 9/10 after 3.5 min at 205 W pod (min 16.2), then pod power fell to 151 W (8/10, a breather). Fits a reserve emptied around min 16.5 with true pod CP about 178-185 W, not 192; 12.7 min at 190 W without fade still says the pre-race 170 W was low.

arguments.text: Finish now 7000 m (radio, min 16.7): end of leg 7, an out leg (north, into current about -0.25; back legs south helped). Pod CP re-corrected at min 17.5 to 182 W (boat 112 W): paddler held 190 W for 13 min without fade, but went 9/10 after 3.5 min at 205 W and dropped to 151 W. Plan: let them recover 1-2 min, then hold near the sustainable shaft power (about 185 W), slightly harder on out legs into the current; no more push cues before 1000 m to go; finish sprint from about 600 m. Possible extra drag: mean push_local over out+back legs fell from about 0 to about -0.10 m/s from min 14 (weed, tired blade or pod reading high); check legs, ratio boat/pod (about 0.60), and consider clear_rudder if it persists. One CP correction left.

arguments.reason: check recovery from the dip (pod power back toward 180 W?) and the drag question

text: told the paddler the finish is 3.8 k away (course shortened); lowered pod CP to 182 W after the 9/10 report and the drop to 151 W; letting them recover.
